values: single-cell transcriptomics can distinguish shifts in cell-state proportions from within-state gene-regulatory changes a capability lacking in bulk profiling.

components.name: proposition
values: trametinib induces a strong transcriptional response in a549 and k562 but not in mcf7 cells consistent with kras and abl mutational status.

values: the dose of many hdac inhibitors governs the magnitude of a cell s response rather than the rate of progression.

values: exogenous acetate pyruvate or citrate can partially rescue cells from hdac inhibitor-induced transcriptional trajectory supporting the acetyl-coa depletion model.

values: sci-plex-derived tc50 values for hdac inhibitors correlate with published biochemical ic50 values.

components.name: proposition
values: nuclear hashing with unmodified ssdna oligos stably labels nuclei and enables sample multiplexing in sci-rna-seq.

values: sci-plex can distinguish compound-specific transcriptional responses and infer viability from cell recovery counts.

values: sci-plex scales to thousands of independent perturbations and provides single-cell resolution transcriptomic readouts.

values: hdac inhibitors induce a transcriptional response consistent with acetyl-coa depletion including upregulation of acss2 acly and genes involved in citrate metabolism.

values: hash oligo labeling enables detection of doublets including within-species doublets with high sensitivity.
